name: scaling-module-lookups-proof
description: The #4601 module-index regression proof module-lookups-proof.mjs and its Jet twin module-lookups-proof/run.jet over the jet_scaling_gate package, #5072 c7. Each case gates the comptime shape (files layout, N=128..1024 and the N=1 baseline) into a fresh proof directory with a stand-in bootstrap compiler from fixtures (JET_SCRATCH_ROOT=scratch holds the build root): linear module lookups pass; quadratic ones exceed the linear envelope; a compiler that never succeeds fails the baseline. The check prints proof/module-lookups-proof.json (the compiler and receipt with the case directory as <case>; objects by field name without null fields) and whether stdout ends with the same result. The other cases: a proof directory that already exists, a missing --root and a missing compiler file (exit 1, the original's uncaught error, nothing printed).
